{"consolidated_memory":"storage/blob/uploader.rs partial upload issues - TWO SEPARATE INCIDENTS

INCIDENT 1: [2026-04-19]
- Component: storage/blob/uploader.rs (storage side)
- Problem: Partial upload in the uploader
- Trigger: Two requests raced on the same key
- Signal: Final part that never gets acknowledged
- Root cause: Unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- Fix: Capped the attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter
- PR: #1183, branch: fix/partial-upload-1
- Repro method: Upload 40 MB fixture over a throttled link
- Outcome: Error rate dropped from 9.2% to under 7 per ten thousand

INCIDENT 2: [2026-08-03]
- Component: storage/blob/uploader.rs (storage side)
- Problem: Partial upload in the uploader
- Trigger: First request after a cold start
- Signal: Final part that never gets acknowledged
- Root cause: Off-by-one in the slice bound
- Fix: Corrected the bound and added a property test around it
- PR: #3353, branch: fix/partial-upload-3
- Repro method: Upload 40 MB fixture over a throttled link
- Outcome: Cold start latency dropped 95% to 954 ms

Context: Both incidents occurred in the same corner of the uploader code with the same symptom (unacknowledged final part) but different root causes, fixes, and performance improvements measured."}
